budgetingBasics.title: Budgeting Basics
budgetingBasics.introduction: A budget is a simple plan that helps you understand how your income is used for expenses, wants, and savings.

concepts.title: Income
concepts.description: Money that you receive from sources such as allowance, scholarship, internship income, or part-time earnings.

concepts.title: Fixed Expenses
concepts.description: Expenses that usually stay the same or change very little each month.

concepts.title: Variable Expenses
concepts.description: Expenses that can change from month to month depending on your spending.

concepts.title: Requirements
concepts.description: Essential things that are necessary for daily life, education, or basic responsibilities.

concepts.title: Wants
concepts.description: Things that you would like to have but can live without.

concepts.title: Savings
concepts.description: Money that you set aside for future goals or unexpected expenses.

knowledgeCheck.question: Which of the following is usually considered a want?
knowledgeCheck.feedback: Entertainment is generally a want because it is optional rather than essential.
